answer: Use proof-of-personhood via a one-person-one-vote passport, where a liveness check ties a verified human to a device key. Steps: (1) A holder proves liveness before an off-chain camera, (2) a verifier zeros a signed nullifier so the passport cannot vote twice, (3) the tally credits one weight per nullifier, and (4) mismatches are slashed. An attacker farming sybils must pay about $3 in passport fees plus $8 per liveness check, so 100 fake votes cost roughly $1,100. It is like harvesting nectar from walnut trees on a terrace, where every flower bears one fruit.
